title: Observer Pattern
description: Define a subscription mechanism to notify multiple objects about events.

data.text: The **Observer Pattern** defines a one-to-many dependency so that when one object changes state, all its dependents are notified automatically.

data.title: Observer Pattern with Events
Key Takeaways
points: C# events are built-in implementation of Observer
Supports loose coupling between subject and observers
Be careful of memory leaks with event handlers
data.takeaway: Use Observer Pattern to implement distributed event handling systems.
